units.source_text: 古歌：“夏夜初眠天即晓，相逢犹似不相逢。”

en.t: An old poem says: "On a summer night, no sooner do I first fall asleep than dawn arrives; though we meet, it is still as if we had not met."

units.source_text: 另一说不是此歌，此处所引古歌不详。

en.t: Another theory says it was not this poem, and the old poem cited here is unidentified.
